result.requirement: The system shall provide real-time dashboards tracking delivery speed, accuracy, and customer satisfaction scores for each Delivery Partner.
result.business_need: The business needs live visibility into agent performance to optimize workforce allocation, identify training gaps, and ensure consistent service quality across the network.
functional_behaviour: The system shall aggregate live metrics including average delivery time, order accuracy rate, and customer feedback scores for each active Delivery Partner.
The system shall update performance indicators in real-time as new Delivery Proof records and Feedback Records are submitted.
The system shall display a visual dashboard accessible to the Fulfillment Supervisor and the Delivery Partner showing current status and historical trends.
The system shall calculate performance scores by correlating Delivery Assignment completion times with the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot and Service Area Definition constraints.
The system shall flag agents whose performance metrics fall below the defined service level thresholds for immediate review.
related_information_requirements: Assigned route and estimated arrival time
Current workload status of the agent
business_rules: A Delivery Partner's performance score must be updated immediately upon the submission of a Delivery Proof record.
Customer satisfaction scores must be weighted equally with delivery speed metrics in the overall performance calculation.
Performance data must be retained for a minimum period sufficient to generate weekly trend reports.
An agent's status must be flagged as 'Underperforming' if their average delivery time exceeds the zone standard for three consecutive shifts.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner has completed five Delivery Assignments with associated Feedback Records and Delivery Proof
acceptance_criteria.when: The Fulfillment Supervisor opens the real-time analytics dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: The dashboard displays the aggregated speed, accuracy, and satisfaction scores for that specific agent

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner submits a Delivery Proof with a late timestamp
acceptance_criteria.when: The system calculates the performance metrics for the current reporting period
acceptance_criteria.then: The agent's delivery speed score is adjusted downward to reflect the delay, and the dashboard updates automatically
